title_en: Private villa for sale in Linz between Dajti park
description_en: • 2 residential floors organized in: Floor 1 ➡️ spacious living room with fireplace and fantastic view. Separate kitchen with veranda. 1 spacious toilet 2nd floor ➡️ corridor, 3 bedrooms each with veranda, 1 toilet. • 1 basement floor with toilet, wine cellar, warehouse. Land area 7000 m2 Building plot 347 m2 Residential area 258.6 m2 • Year of construction 2020. • Surrounded by a stone wall. • All construction materials and furnishings are brought from Italy. • Has regular documents. • Special private road only for the villa. • Camera system both outside and inside it. • It is supplied with water from the garden • Solar panels • Water filtration • Special space which has been prepared to place 2 swimming pools. • Parking space inside the villa • Yard paved with decorative grass and trees • Dedicated space for camping The villa offers peace and comfort Fantastic views and privacy 🏞️ Sale price 600,000 euros
